text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During her first three years in the Twinkle Series,
Durandal wielded that "Holy Sword"—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She claimed countless sprint and mile titles.
And what's more—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Here too—!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: This race, too—!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: No matter who the opponent may be—!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
My Holy Sword knows no blemish!
For I, the knight Durendal—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Only the final 3 furlongs are the battlefield!
Everything before that is nothing more than a military parade!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An end-closer in the sprint division.
She made a name for herself as an extraordinary heroine.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Look, look, it's Durandal and her Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
So cool, right? Like a king and knight
bound by destiny!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
My King. Please walk half a step ahead.
I shall remain by your side at all times.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Durandal is always by my side.
Just having her there was so reassuring.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Through work, I often interacted
with other Umamusume, but...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
No no no waaaaay!
I'm definitely not moving from this spot~!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: My King, let us charge forward decisively and aggressively.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: You are the one who must tell her firmly.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: What is it, you...?
choice_data_list: If you move out of the way, I'll give you a treat!
If you step aside, I'll give you some sweets!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Sweets~? You think that kind of thing will work on m—...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Just this once, okay? This is a special exception.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Giving in to persuasion, Sweep Tosho vacated the area.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: My King, thank you for your hard work.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even when I'm on the verge of losing heart,
Durandal gives me courage.
I felt as if I had grown a whole size bigger.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
You're an interesting one.
Approaching me and making a negotiation pitch, no less.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Very well.
I think you and I will get along quite nicely.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Negotiating assertively with Dream Journey, the mysteriously shrewd Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Wah! Then Big Brother,
will you watch Curren run?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Wah! Then Big Sister,
will you watch Curren run?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yay, yay, I did it♪
Dote on me lots and lo~ts, okay?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
My King!
You must not succumb to the power of cuteness!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: You must remain firm and resolute. Do not forget your own station.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Interacting with the cute Umamusume, Curren Chan, while keeping a proper distance, and then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, I learned that an absolute "king" reigned over Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
What is with this lineup of prospective Trainers?
Utterly out of the question.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
There is not a single thing you could offer me.
I have no desire to even meet with you.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I see... But Orfe,
there is another interesting Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hoh, an interesting Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"So you are the Trainer touted
as possessing the caliber of a King?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This Umamusume is Orfevre.
Known as the King of the Turf, she is a tyrannical Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She has a reputation for being an Umamusume no trainer can handle, but...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
How rude of you, Orfe-san.
This person is by no means a false vessel.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
A true king who rose from humble beginnings to reign supreme.
One look into their eyes should tell you everything.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Ho... Not intimidated in the least before me, are you?
You certainly seem to have guts.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Very well. I shall grant you a special opportunity.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Durandal. This Trainer whom you have raised,
I shall take them for myself.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
From now on is my era...
Show me what your shrewd abilities can do.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That Orfevre acknowledged me.
If that's the case...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: This, too, was given to me by Durandal...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, Orfe-san.
This person is someone capable of matching you on equal footing.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Then Orfevre-san, my king...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm definitely not handing it over!
As if I ever would!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Our knightly tale is far from over.
My King, let us be on our way."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Heh, refusing to let go? Very well then.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I shall remember this.
As a candidate to accompany me when I make my appearances.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
My King. You will surely get to know
many more Umamusume from here on out. Watching over that—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: "I will see this through to the very end. As the 'Holy Sword' that is ever by your side."
choice_data_list: Together forever... is that what you mean?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Yes. And whenever you lose your way,
please draw this "Holy Sword" at any time.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
No matter when, no matter where, I will become it.
Your—courage!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Every Trainer starts out as a novice.
Lacking achievements, ability, and decisiveness. However...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Things will not remain this way forever. A turning point will surely come.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Durandal. The legendary holy sword
that only a true hero was permitted to wield.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Only by taking the sword of destiny in hand... does a king
truly begin walking the path to their authentic self.
